h2: Handyman Uluwatu – Small Repairs Sorted in a Single Visit
intro: Living on the Bukit means your villa deals with salt spray, hard limestone water and limited mains supply every single day. A Handyman Uluwatu visit bundles all those small niggles—sticking doors, corroded handles, peeling silicone—into one trip so you are not chasing five different tradespeople up separate switchbacks.

sections.h3: Salt Wind, Hard Water and What They Do to Your Fittings
sections.text: Cliff-top villas in Ungasan and Bingin take a daily hit from salt spray drifting off the Indian Ocean. Metal tap handles, pool ladders and window hardware corrode faster than they would inland, while hard limestone water builds scale inside shower heads and behind glass panels. Hinges seize, mosquito-screen frames warp, and bathroom silicone turns black within a few wet seasons. Rather than booking separate tradespeople for each symptom, one handyman visit can address several of these wear points at once.

sections.h3: What We Usually Fix Across Pecatu and the Wider Bukit
sections.text: The most common requests here are doors that stick after the humidity cycle, locks whose cylinders have seized from salt air, torn mosquito screens on ocean-facing rooms, and bathroom silicone that has gone mouldy or cracked. We also re-mount shelves and curtain rails that shifted in the frame, hang TV brackets, and assemble flat-pack furniture after a tenant move-in. If your villa manager has a list of five small items, we knock them all out in a single trip.

sections.h3: Send Photos on WhatsApp – Get a Quote Before We Drive Out
sections.text: The fastest way to get a quote is a short WhatsApp message with two or three photos of each issue: a close-up of the stuck hinge, the mouldy silicone line, the bent screen frame. Mention how many doors, locks or shelves are involved, and whether access is straightforward—ground floor, pool deck, upstairs via stairs. Pricing depends on the scope, so once we see what you are dealing with we send back a clear figure before anyone drives up the Bukit.

sections.h3: Small Habits That Save You Bigger Repairs Later
sections.text: A ten-minute weekly wipe-down of exposed tap handles, pool ladders and door hinges with fresh water slows salt corrosion dramatically. Check your tank float valve each month; on the Bukit a stuck float can overflow a full tank overnight. Replace bathroom silicone at the first sign of cracking rather than waiting for mould to set in. And if a hinge starts dragging, a few drops of oil now saves a full replacement later.

faq.q: Do you cover villas in Bingin, Ungasan and Labuan Sait?
faq.a: Yes—we work across the whole Uluwatu Bukit, from Bingin down through Pecatu to Labuan Sait. Send us your address on WhatsApp and we will confirm it fits our route that day.

faq.q: How do I get a price when I have four or five different small jobs?
faq.a: Just photograph each item and send them together in one WhatsApp message. We look at the combined scope and reply with a single quote, so you pay for one visit instead of several.

faq.q: Can you handle both a re-siliconing job and a furniture assembly in the same trip?
faq.a: That is exactly what the service is designed for. As long as the tasks are small-repair level—silicone, doors, screens, shelves, flat-pack assembly—we bundle them into one appointment and finish everything before leaving.
